# Cratebox

> DJ software for the Pioneer DDJ-FLX4, in one public monorepo (github.com/zonahbear/Cratebox, owner Jonah): a
> browser player, a Rust app for Linux (Cratebox OS) and Windows, and a native iOS app. Worked on by several AI
> agents in turn (Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Gemini, Grok, Copilot); the repo is their only shared memory.

Read the first four in order, then only the map of the app you touch.

## Start here

- [.handoffs/LATEST.md](.handoffs/LATEST.md): savestate. Where the last agent stopped; exact next steps.
- [.agent/SYSTEM_PROMPT.md](.agent/SYSTEM_PROMPT.md): hard rules and rules of engagement (start, handoff, bugs, features).
- [.agent/CONTEXT_MAP.md](.agent/CONTEXT_MAP.md): architecture map, branches, verification commands, workflows.
- [.agent/GLOBAL_PLAN.json](.agent/GLOBAL_PLAN.json): machine-readable task list (status, owner, branch, depends_on).
- [TODO.md](TODO.md): every open item in priority order; what waits on Jonah; where the iOS code lives right now.

## Apps

- [apps/web/AGENTS.md](apps/web/AGENTS.md): web player `apps/web/cratebox.html` (source of truth) and the website.
- [apps/linux/AGENTS.md](apps/linux/AGENTS.md): Rust app, Cratebox OS ISO, Windows build.
- [apps/ios-suite/AGENTS.md](apps/ios-suite/AGENTS.md): Swift iOS app, Deck Bridge.

## Reviews and handoffs

- [.agent/REVIEW.md](.agent/REVIEW.md): review checklist.
- [.handoffs/](.handoffs/): memos `<YYYYMMDD-HHMM>Z_<agent>_<TASK-ID>_<role>.md` (time-stamped so parallel branches don't collide), newest copied to LATEST.md.
- [.github/pull_request_template.md](.github/pull_request_template.md): what every PR states.

## Optional

- Per-app history: `apps/<app>/.claudes/breadcrumbs.md`; user-facing changes: `apps/<app>/CHANGELOG.md`.
